items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: who later played with Jimmy Lunceford

ctx.x: And he played a little saxaphone too. But anyway, getting back to the first black nightclub, well we had -- we were fortunate enough to get hold of a man by the name of Eddie Thompkins on trumpet, who later played with Jimmy Lunceford and was an outstanding trumpet player, and the rest of the guys --
Now what band is this, Budd?
